title: Hole Them All
shortDescription: Hole Them All is a satisfying color puzzle game where you guide colorful crowds into the right holes
fullDescription:
Tap a hole, and matching crowds will run into it. Choose the right holes in the right order, collect the needed number of characters, and clear the board. Each level is a small logic puzzle where color matching, order of actions, and smart decisions matter.

🧠 Sounds simple?
As you progress, levels become more challenging. New colors, bigger crowds, locked areas, and different hole requirements make every move important. Think ahead, open the right paths, and avoid wasting space on the wrong choices.

🎮 How to play:
- Tap a colored hole
- Matching crowds run into the selected hole
- Fill each hole with the required number of characters
- Complete all holes and clear the board
- Use boosters when you need help

✨ Why you’ll love it:
- Simple tap controls
- Satisfying crowd movement
- Fun color sorting gameplay
- Clear goals and relaxing puzzle flow
- Many levels with growing difficulty
- Boosters for tricky situations

If you enjoy color sorting games, crowd puzzles, matching games, or relaxing brain teasers, Hole Them All gives you an easy-to-learn and satisfying puzzle experience.

🎯 Tap the right holes, sort the crowds, and complete every colorful level!
